_comment: Copy to <repo>/.agents/entry.json and edit. Paths are relative to the repo root.
_id_format_note: 'legacy' gives uid-abc-123 (existing repos only). 'modern' gives prefixed Crockford base32 — use this for new projects.

collection._middle_note: Legacy only — rewrites uid-XXX-123 to uid-col-123.

stamp._stamp_note: Dotted JSON paths to write the ID into. Integers index lists: 'price1.product.products.0'. Use '{id:cus-}' to swap the leading prefix for a sibling ID.
